ALLTHINGS140 Radio — Android App Privacy Notice

This native Android app is designed to play the ALLTHINGS140 Radio live stream and display public station information. The native app does not require an account and does not request access to your location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone, SMS, call history, or advertising identifier.

The app connects over HTTPS to ALLTHINGS140 Radio stream, status, and website services. Like normal internet services, those servers and hosting/network providers can receive technical request information such as IP address, request time, and user-agent data needed to deliver content, maintain reliability, and protect the service.

The native app does not include an advertising SDK or analytics SDK in this release. It does not sell personal data.

The in-app Visuals page is an optional station web experience and can use normal first-party browser storage needed to render the page. The Website button opens your device browser rather than collecting website form data inside the native app.

Data retention and deletion: the native radio player does not create a user profile or account database. Server logs may be retained by station or infrastructure providers for operational/security purposes according to the final published station privacy policy. Information submitted on the external station website is governed by the station website privacy policy and its service providers.

Developer/operator: ALLTHINGS140 Radio. Privacy questions or applicable deletion requests can be submitted through the contact methods on allthings140radio.online. This notice applies to the native Android app and its embedded Visuals page; external websites and third-party services have their own policies.
